entities.summary: British East India Company, a political institution in Bangladesh during Mughal Bengal and Economic Powerhouse (1700–1757). Grew from Akbar and Mughal Conquest and Dhaka. Led to the emergence of East India Company and Nawab Siraj ud-Daulah captures Calcutta and the Black Hole incident.
